homepage.faqSubtitle: At Boutiique Vastraa, we believe that finding the perfect saree should be a delightful and effortless experience. Here are answers to some of the most common questions our customers ask.

faqs.question: Are your sarees authentic handloom?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every saree in our handloom collection comes with the official Silk Mark or Handloom Mark certification, sourced directly from regional artisans.

faqs.question: Do you customize blouse designs?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We offer custom tailoring services for blouses and petticoats. You can select your measurements on the product detail page.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a hassle-free 7-day return policy on all unworn items with tags intact, except for custom tailored products.

faqs.question: How do I care for my silk sarees?
faqs.answer: Dry clean only is recommended for all our pure silk, Banarasi, and delicate handloom sarees to maintain their color, drape, and zari work.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit/debit cards, UPI/UPI QR, net banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD) for pin codes across India.

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Orders are dispatched within 24-48 hours. Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days across India. Custom tailored orders may take an additional 3 days.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes! We ship worldwide. International delivery rates are calculated at checkout, and orders usually arrive within 7-12 business days.

faqs.question: How can I track my order status?
faqs.answer: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking link via email and SMS/WhatsApp. You can also track it directly on our 'Track Order' page.

faqs.question: Are there any shipping charges?
faqs.answer: No. All prices listed on our boutique store are fully inclusive of taxes. Shipping is completely free for all orders delivered within India.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or modify my order after placing it?
faqs.answer: You can cancel or modify your order within 12 hours of placement by emailing us at boutiiquevastraa@gmail.com or contacting customer support on WhatsApp.
